description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenCdmSessionPrivate class, which manages DRM sessions in a media playback context. It uses Google Test framework to verify behaviors such as initialization, license request handling, session management, and metadata addition, with mock dependencies for backend interactions and callbacks.

classes.name: OpenCdmSessionTests
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing OpenCdmSessionPrivate functionalities, including setup, utility methods, and various test cases.

methods.name: createSut
methods.description: Creates an instance of OpenCDMSessionPrivate with default or specified license type.

methods.name: createInvalidSut
methods.description: Creates an instance of OpenCDMSessionPrivate with null backend and dispatcher to test failure scenarios.

methods.name: initializeSut
methods.description: Initializes the session, setting up backend and dispatcher mocks to simulate successful creation.

methods.name: requestLicense
methods.description: Simulates a license request by invoking the callback with challenge data.

methods.name: updateKeyStatus
methods.description: Updates the key status and verifies callback invocations.

methods.name: fillBuffers
methods.description: Allocates and fills GstBuffers with test data for metadata tests.

methods.name: verifyMetadata
methods.description: Checks that protection metadata added to buffer matches expected values.

methods.name: verifyMetadataAdditionalFields
methods.description: Verifies additional protection metadata fields like cipher mode and block sizes.

methods.name: addGstProtectionMeta
methods.description: Creates and attaches a GstProtectionMeta to the buffer with test data.
